channel.title: Bahar Hadadi
channel.description: PhD in Computer Science. Research on log analysis, anomaly detection, and LLMs for software systems.

item.title: About — Dr. Bahar Hadadi
item.description: PhD graduate in Computer Science from the University of Ottawa with research experience in ML-based failure prediction and anomaly detection on software logs.

item.title: LLM meets ML: Data-efficient Anomaly Detection on Unstable Logs (TOSEM 2025)
item.description: FlexLog: a hybrid ULAD approach combining ML models with an LLM (Mistral) via ensemble learning, with cache and RAG.

item.title: Anomaly Detection on Unstable Logs with GPT Models (arXiv 2024)
item.description: Experimental comparison of fine-tuned LLMs and baselines for anomaly detection on unstable logs; prompt vs fine-tuning insights.

item.title: Systematic Evaluation of Deep Learning Models for Log-based Failure Prediction (EMSE 2024)
item.description: Systematic study of embedding strategies and DL encoders (RNN/CNN/Transformer) for failure prediction; includes large-scale synthetic datasets.
